fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is a semiconductor company providing AI accelerators, microprocessors, and GPUs across three business divisions: Data Center, Client and Gaming, and Embedded, operating brands including AMD Ryzen, Radeon, and Instinct.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD sells FPGAs, adaptive SoCs, and computing and network acceleration boards to OEMs, cloud service providers, and system integrators, and was founded in 1969 with headquarters in Santa Clara, California.
